description: This file defines the User controller class within the Opencart admin module. It manages user-related functionalities such as listing users, displaying and processing user forms, enabling/disabling/deleting users, authorization, login, log viewing, and autocomplete features. It interacts with models like 'user/user' and 'user/user_group', and loads various views for rendering user data.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Controller class for managing admin user operations such as listing, creating, editing, enabling/disabling, deleting, and authorizing users within the Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the user list page, set up breadcrumbs, load user groups, and prepare view data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the default listing of users, returning the user list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the list of users based on filters and pagination, returning the rendered user list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a user, pre-filling data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the submission of the user form, performing validation and saving data via the user model, returning JSON response.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected users by updating their status via the model, with permission check.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected users by updating their status via the model, with permission check.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected users from the database after permission validation.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Displays authorization details for a user.

methods.name: getAuthorize
methods.description: Fetches and renders the list of authorizations for a specific user.

methods.name: deleteAuthorize
methods.description: Deletes a specific user authorization, possibly forcing logout if token matches.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Displays login history for a user.

methods.name: getLogin
methods.description: Fetches and renders login history for a given user.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides an autocomplete list for user search, based on username, name, or email filters.
